text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)... If you're aiming 
to be a top-class stayer—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely want this title. Trainer, 
I—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a Spring Tenno Sho 
Umamusume!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's one of the greatest honors, 
after all.

Yeah, it's one of the greatest honors, 
after all.

text_block_list.text:
That Shield is undeniably proof of the 
strong. Especially—

For Narita Top Road, with her strong 
stayer aptitudes, it was a coveted medal. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: To take it, there's a rival I must defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
She has grown terrifyingly strong, that 
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's win! Together, the two of us!
Yeah, let's win! The two of us together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If our hearts are united as one, we 
can definitely stand up against any rival, 
no matter how tough!

The greatest opponent standing in my way 
today. That is, of course—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Welcome, Top Road-san. To the 
theater of terror, presented by yours 
truly!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready to dance with the 
Overlord—no, the Demon King? Let your 
guard down, and your body will freeze in 
an instant.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'm ready, Opera O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This year, I will become an Umamusume who 
surpasses both you and Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"As the first step, today... I cannot 
lose!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, excellent. Then let us put it to 
the test, shall we?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whether you are truly a horse girl who 
won't become a sacrifice to the Supreme 
King. And the current balance of power 
between us!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hrmm~, Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Top Road-san is...
choice_data_list: You can win... you can win this...
You can win... you really can...

text_block_list.text:
I believed in her. The most hardworking 
Umamusume, who had run alongside me all 
the way to this point.

"I was certain that if it were her, she 
would shine even brighter than T.M. Opera 
O."
